decisions.statement: The scan is written by hand rather than handed to a Lua runtime.
A comment is skipped wherever a value could begin.
A long-bracket comment is skipped whole.
A table whose first entry has no key is read as an array.
A table mixing a bare entry with a named key is read as a record.
The first entry of a Lua array is renumbered on the way out.
A `nil` in the file is read as null.
A named variable whose value is no table is refused.

definition: the text of a saved-variables file read into plain data
